## Accepted execution contract v2 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is1000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Accepted activation: native durable-prefix grouping

Activated by the accepted #5091 decision (https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243), landed in #5100. The selected scope is bounded native update durable-prefix grouping using #5093 owned plans and the existing ordered publisher/barrier. Primary deliverable is a PR after merged #5093. #5094 is a required native blocker of #5096 and #5097; those GitHub dependency edges are verified. The original unactivated retirement option no longer applies.

H0 #5101 is merged in #5102 at af56fe515668b5c8ddf7d1b06a01f251fefcf8d6. This completes measurement prerequisites, with no runtime or mutation-performance acceptance. No new WAL actor or broad preparation scheduler is selected.

## Goal and existing substrate

Allow useful native request preparation outside the authoritative serialized commit path, under finite in-flight request/owned-byte budgets, while one ordered committer validates state, assigns identities, publishes all primary/secondary effects and returns the selected durable ACK.

[PreparedInsertBatch](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/collections/prepared_insert.go#L362) provides single-use, owned, identity-free preparation for unindexed semantic-stream JSON. Consume completed #4819's owned single-use preparation contract without reopening its loader delivery or inheriting its 4.5 GiB cap. It does not cover the selected indexed native row workload and its sealed-root completion is stronger than ordinary command-WAL ACK. [TryUpsertTypedBatchGroup](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/collections/typed_upsert_group.go#L49) already bounds insert-only/no-unique concurrent groups; backend durable-prefix intents already append individual frames, close their dependencies and publish grouped effects. Backend finalization already releases write/commit serialization before durability preparation under durablePublishMu. Do not propose moving already-outside-lock sync as a new change. Extend selected admission and ownership seams; do not create another WAL actor or ACK model. The existing update combiner is not evidence that typed direct updates are grouped.

## Architecture scope

Reuse [#5093](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5093)'s immutable source-aware plan inputs. Private preparation may validate owned input/schema and encode type/index-key work independent of authoritative state. Old-row binding, uniqueness/final-owner conflict checks, authoritative LSN/PartID/asset identities, command append, exact dependency sync, publication and ACK remain at ordered commit. Bound backing capacities and preparation, command, asset and publication scratch together; cancellation/abandonment releases credit and pins, shutdown drains ownership, stale state fails before append or follows existing post-append ambiguity rules.

If actual sync waiting is dominant and admitted concurrent requests exist, extend the existing typed durable-prefix group only for a documented supported mutation/unique-conflict shape. Prove disjoint/conflicting request ordering and atomic per-request visibility; preserve individual deterministic commands and dependency-closed durable prefix. Measure grouping throughput and p95/p99/queue wait; bound batching wait so throughput does not hide latency regressions. Serial C inputs are not a groupcommit proof.

#4877 owns MVCC multi-record visibility/durable-wait fences; #5044 owns COW cuts/publication. Consume their exact landed capability if needed. This packet owns collection native preparation/group admission only; refresh PR #4821/#4315 validator ownership before shared command work.

## Test-first and performance gates

Before implementation characterize public durable/native execution and add failing single-use/input ownership/finite admission/cancel-close tests for the selected seam. Test FIFO/deterministic conflict handling, stale schema/row revalidation, unique swaps/races, no partial publication, input reuse, no pre-append side effects, barriers spanning external assets, sync/publish cuts and reopen. Reusing existing group machinery still needs real public admission counters.

- [x] [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) activation and selected collection-native ownership recorded; unsupported admission remains a cheap pre-append fallback/refusal.
- [ ] Finite queue/backing-byte credit includes all owned scratch until the correct ACK/completion boundary.
- [ ] Ordered state/identity assignment, durable closure, atomic publication and failure semantics pass.
- [ ] Selected preparation/group metric materially improves versus identical serial/depth-zero/existing-group controls; CPU/wall, queue wait, tail latency, objects/bytes, retained memory and physical sync/request reported.
- [ ] Docs in `concurrency-paradigms.md`, `collections-write-domain.md`, durability/command-WAL/recovery, native mutation guide and verification match the real public path.


## Shared execution contract

Parent: [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Planning base: `b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a`; recheck affected production paths and owners before implementation. Read the parent's semantic, performance, documentation and reassessment contract.

The runtime implementation contract is active under the accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) decision. This PR is a **performance-objective** packet. Prove the real public caller → eligibility → optimized primitive → fallback, with path/work counters; helper-only timings are insufficient. First capture the named invariant failing for the intended reason, or record a justified characterization exception for a behavior-preserving refactor. Run affected races, recovery/reopen and fault tests. Compare identical before/after commands and equivalent returned data, visibility, ownership and durable ACKs; report latency/throughput, B/op, allocs/op, setup/first-use, retained/peak memory and relevant storage/I/O/work counters. Charge allocations by row/request/batch/setup, and account for backing capacity and pins. Minimize avoidable copies/temporary representations before completion.

[#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) freezes the workload, numeric objective/budgets and noise policy **before candidate measurements**, from phase-attributed baselines. A pass requires the structural gate below and a repeatable material improvement beyond that policy; no-regression alone does not pass. If improvement is insufficient, profile and revise this packet or map a blocking replacement before final qualification. Unexplained material regressions block; an accepted necessary residual needs evidence, alternatives and explicit acceptance.

Use an isolated topic branch and PR; preserve unrelated work. Current repository policy requires a PR and strict current-head `TreeDB required gate`; the required formal-approval count is zero. Refresh rules before merge. Request credit-consuming AI review only for mature code/tests/performance evidence/docs, resolve findings, and repeat only for changed evidence. No execution or merge is performed by publishing these issues.



## Constructor prerequisite selected — 2026-10-08, 08:28 UTC

Required final acceptance/merge prerequisite: [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), the same-Pager constructor resident account, complete shared loans, pre-WAL capacity envelope and joined teardown. The historical Pager is born before the former first-request master, so attaching a request factory cannot certify its backing. Component construction can continue provisionally; full finite/native admission and this node's final runtime acceptance require #5113 accepted and merged with actual producer/retained-lifetime census and unchanged whole128MiB fit. No larger cap, default change, first-request reattribution, second budget/registry or external unfrozen ABI.
